candidates.summary: Index checks that the render page was captured and then links source and help unconditionally, two pages the crawl is free to skip
candidates.failure_scenario: Crawler.Run logs and continues on a fetch error or a non-200 for any seed (crawl.go: `! %s: %v` then continue, `! %s: HTTP %d` then continue), and $source/$help are seeds like the render page. A realm whose render page came back 200 while its $source 500'd gets a row whose source link points at r/x/leaf/_t/source/, a directory Crawler.Write never created, so the preview homepage serves a 404 for it. The row's own guard at 170 shows the author knew the crawl can miss a page; the two other links on the same row are not behind it.

candidates.summary: Index recomputes each row's path with urlToFile instead of reading the page's own File, so it silently drops Crawler.Prefix
candidates.failure_scenario: page.File is path.Join(c.Prefix, urlToFile(u)) and writePages writes exactly there, but Index rebuilds the href from urlToFile alone. The two agree only because render() calls Index with the head crawler, whose Prefix is ""; the other Crawler in the program, the merge-base one, carries Prefix "_before". Point Index at any prefixed crawler, now or in the next change that adds one, and every link on the preview homepage 404s while the page renders as if fine. c.pages[u].File is the value already computed and already used for writing.
candidates.verify_by: Index(&Plan{Realms:["gno.land/r/x/leaf"]}, crawler with Prefix "_before") and compare the href with c.pages["/r/x/leaf"].File
candidates.evidence: --- FAIL: TestB5ReachIndexHonorsCrawlerPrefix: index links a path the crawler never wrote; page lives at "_before/r/x/leaf/index.html"; emitted href="r/x/leaf/"
